items.summary: Retain these evidence-backed opportunities as deferred backlog only; do not create queue work this cycle. 1) saveusfarms.com: refresh the title/meta treatment for the article with 1,668 impressions, position 10.5, and 0 clicks; metric is organic CTR/clicks after 100 new impressions; smallest reversible prototype is metadata-only with rollback. 2) deeppenetrations.com: improve the /reviews/liquid-wrench search result, which has 95 impressions, position 2.8, and 0 clicks; metric is CTR/clicks after 100 new impressions; prototype is title/description copy only. 3) Fleet UX component pattern: prototype one accessible CTA/card pattern inspired by shadcn-ui/ui. The lab found MIT licensing, three of three bounded checks passed, and no dependency installation or production access; risks are dependency/supply-chain review, Astro/Cloudflare compatibility, bundle impact, and maintenance drift. Smallest prototype is a manually copied isolated component in one preview, with no package adoption. Mermaid remains research-only: MIT licensed and relevant to content diagrams, but native checks were unavailable and SVG sanitization/page weight require review. Markitdown is MIT licensed with eight of eight bounded checks passing, but introduces Python/runtime and document-parser security review; prototype only as an offline content transformation fixture. Expected learning is whether the isolated pattern or metadata change improves measurable search/CTA behavior without new tracking, spend, credentials, domains, or deployment. Financial return, causal lift, and revenue attribution remain unknown.
